name: Cobalt and Rose

colormaps.density: cr_density: white, pale blue, cobalt, deep indigo
colormaps.exactness: cr_exact: white, pale rose, rose, deep raspberry
colormaps.rule: every map is pure white at its zero end; no grey or black backgrounds

rules: Rose is reserved for the method the paper argues for.
Cobalt marks the strongest alternative; at most one cobalt series per panel.
Baselines are blue-greys distinguished by dash pattern, never by hue.
Violet only for theory predictions and reference levels (thin dotted lines).
White backgrounds everywhere; the training band is a pale blue tint, not grey.
No default matplotlib colours, frames, legends, grids or titles; labels sit at line ends.
